Offroad_TemperatureTooHigh.text: Device overheated. The system is cooling down before starting. Current internal component temperature: %1.

Offroad_ConnectivityNeededPrompt.text: Update check needed. Connect to the internet to check for updates. If you don't connect, sunnypilot won't engage in %1.
Offroad_ConnectivityNeededPrompt._comment: Set extra field to number of days

Offroad_ConnectivityNeeded.text: Connect to the internet. sunnypilot won't automatically start until it connects to the internet to check for updates.

Offroad_UpdateFailed.text: Update failed. Ensure the software is correctly installed. Uninstall and re-install if this error persists, or reflash the device at flash.comma.ai.

Offroad_ChestnutBranch.text: Chestnut detected! Switch to the %1 branch to use chestnut-class models.

Offroad_ChestnutModelError.text: Chestnut model error. Restart the car to retry.

Offroad_ChestnutNotDetected.text: Chestnut not detected. Check USB and 12V connections, then restart the car.

Offroad_ChestnutUpdateFailed.text: Chestnut update failed. Check the USB cable.

Offroad_ChestnutUsbSlow.text: Chestnut USB link is slow. Check the USB cable. The current speed is %1.

Offroad_UnregisteredHardware.text: Device not registered. This device failed to register with comma.ai, so it won't connect or upload to comma.ai servers and receives no support. If you purchased it at comma.ai/shop, open a ticket at comma.ai/support.

Offroad_UploadsIgnored.text: Uploads ignored. Uploads are being ignored due to a potential safety policy violation. Contact comma.ai/support if you believe this was made in error.

Offroad_CarUnrecognized.text: Car not recognized. sunnypilot was unable to identify your car. It's either unsupported or its ECUs are not recognized. Please select your vehicle manually at https://www.sunnylink.ai/. Need help? Visit https://community.sunnypilot.ai/

Offroad_Recalibration.text: Device mount changed. sunnypilot detected a change in the device's mounting position. Ensure the device is fully seated in the mount and the mount is firmly secured to the windshield.

Offroad_OSMUpdateRequired.text:
OpenStreetMap database is out of date. New maps must be downloaded if you wish to continue using OpenStreetMap data for Enhanced Speed Control and road name display.

%1

Offroad_DriverMonitoringUncertain.text: Poor driver visibility. Ensure the device has a clear view of the driver, which can be checked in the device settings. Extreme lighting conditions or unconventional mounting positions may also trigger this alert.

Offroad_ExcessiveActuation.text: Excessive %1 actuation. This was detected on your last drive. Please visit https://community.sunnypilot.ai/ and share your device's Dongle ID for troubleshooting.
Offroad_ExcessiveActuation._comment: Set extra field to lateral or longitudinal.

Offroad_TiciSupport.text: Unsupported branch detected - The current version of %1 branch is no longer supported on the comma three. Please go to [Device > Software] and install a supported branch with -tici in the branch name for the comma three.
Offroad_TiciSupport._comment: Set extra field to the current branch name.

Offroad_Pairing.text: Finish setup. Pair your device with comma connect to view recent drives and bookmarked routes.
